contract.task_clause:
Your client has asked you to develop a public relations campaign to promote a college tuition savings program using new technologies. What is the most appropriate first step?
Option A: Research pricing and development costs for different services.
Option B: Develop a survey to discover which factors impact families' savings.
Option C: Conduct a situation analysis to gain a better understanding of the issue.
Option D: Hold a focus group to determine which messages are most effective for the program.
